","./assets/trainers/agatha.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/beauty.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/biker.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/birdkeeper.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/blackbelt.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/blaine.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/brock.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/bruno.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/bugcatcher.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/burglar.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/channeler.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/cooltrainerf.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/cooltrainerm.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/cueball.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/engineer.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/erika.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/fisher.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/gambler.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/gentleman.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/giovanni.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/hiker.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/jessiejames.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/jr.trainerf.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/jr.trainerm.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/juggler.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/koga.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/lance.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/lass.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/lorelei.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/lt.surge.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/misty.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/pokemaniac.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/prof.oak.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/psychic.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/rival1.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/rival2.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/rival3.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/rocker.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/rocket.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/sabrina.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/sailor.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/scientist.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/supernerd.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/swimmer.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/tamer.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/trainers/youngster.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/ui/bag.png":"data:image/png;base64,","./assets/ui/level_up_banner.png":"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAEAAAAAoBAMAAAC84OHaAAAAMFBMVEX///////9qWnMAAADV5v+9ze7u7v9qrMVai7R7xc0AAAAAAAB7xf8AAIv/g4OkAACBCwTfAAAAZUlEQVQ4jWNgNsYPGIxn4gcMltPL8QIGS/zyg0MBmrcN0DUwoHnbGEMBGr+ZcgVmLqhgABSgg2Z6KHDBD4LpoQA9YNDB0FBgHIofMBDM/mgmBjOgg8GnwBVTAZq3jTEUoGd/dHkAklibMaYyOv0AAAAASUVORK5CYII=","./assets/ui/shiny_star.png":"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAgAAAAQBAMAAADZpCNOAAAAMFBMVEUAAAD/1VK9lBAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAl5W2TAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAACJJREFUCJljYCAWMMIIQUFBAQZGQUEQUwAoJCAIEmeEqAIADtwAroWcfFsAAAAASUVORK5CYII="};</script>

    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#07111f" />
    <meta name="description" content="Build a team from the original 151, battle for experience and coins, shop for items, and catch wild Pokémon in Safari mode." />
    <title>Yellow Stadium</title>
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Ccircle cx='32' cy='32' r='29' fill='%23f5c542' stroke='%2307111f' stroke-width='6'/%3E%3Cpath d='M4 32h56' stroke='%2307111f' stroke-width='6'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='32' cy='32' r='10' fill='%23f5f7eb' stroke='%2307111f' stroke-width='6'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
    <style>
:root {
  --ink: #07111f;
  --navy: #0b1e35;
  --navy-2: #102b49;
  --blue: #1b5f88;
  --yellow: #f5c542;
  --cream: #f5f7eb;
  --mint: #75e0b1;
  --red: #ef5c5c;
  --muted: #94a7b8;
  --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
  font-family: "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--cream);
  background: var(--ink);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; min-height: 100vh; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%, #183c61 0, var(--ink) 52%); }
button { font: inherit; }
button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

.shell { width: min(1180px, 100%); min-height: 100vh; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 22px 32px; }
.topbar { min-height: 74px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); gap: 20px; }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; letter-spacing: .14em; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; }
.brand b { color: var(--yellow); }
.brand-mark { width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 3px solid var(--yellow); border-radius: 50%; position: relative; display: inline-block; }
.brand-mark::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -3px; right: -3px; top: 9px; height: 3px; background: var(--yellow); }
.brand-mark::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 3px solid var(--yellow); border-radius: 50%; left: 6px; top: 5px; background: var(--ink); }
.record { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.record b { color: var(--cream); font-size: 1rem; margin-right: 4px; }
.coin-bank i, .shop-balance span { color: var(--yellow); font-style: normal; margin-right: 5px; text-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(245,197,66,.5); }
.music-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(16,43,73,.75); color: var(--yellow); padding: 4px 9px; cursor: pointer; }
.music-button:hover { border-color: var(--yellow); }
.music-button span { font-size: 1rem; }
.music-button b { margin: 0; color: var(--cream); font-size: .66rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.music-button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--muted); background: transparent; }
.music-button[aria-pressed="true"] b { color: var(--muted); }
.text-button { color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 4px 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }

.mode-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding-top: 12px; }
.nav-button { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.nav-button.active { color: var(--yellow); border-color: var(--yellow); }
.team-builder-controls { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .64rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.team-builder-controls > div:first-of-type { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.team-builder-controls button { width: 36px; height: 28px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 900; }
.team-builder-controls button.active { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); }
.team-builder-controls .selection-readout { min-width: 0; }
.selection-readout b { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; }

.screen { margin-top: 28px; }
.onboarding-screen { max-width: 980px; margin: 52px auto 0; }
.onboarding-copy { max-width: 630px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; }
.starter-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-top: 30px; }
.starter-card { position: relative; min-height: 260px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(27,95,136,.3), rgba(7,17,31,.96)); color: var(--cream); padding: 17px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
.starter-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--yellow); }
.starter-card img { display: block; width: 170px; height: 170px; margin: 10px auto 0; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); }
.starter-card strong { display: block; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.starter-card small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.egg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(220px, 320px)); gap: 18px; margin: 30px 0 26px; }
.egg-card { min-height: 260px; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(245,197,66,.13), transparent 40%), var(--navy); color: var(--cream); cursor: pointer; }
.egg-card:not(.hatched):hover .egg-shape { animation: eggWobble .5s ease; }
.egg-card.hatched { cursor: default; border-color: var(--yellow); }
.egg-shape { width: 102px; height: 132px; border-radius: 52% 48% 45% 45% / 62% 62% 38% 38%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 65% 28%, var(--yellow) 0 8px, transparent 9px), radial-gradient(circle at 31% 54%, #7fc4df 0 10px, transparent 11px), var(--cream); box-shadow: inset -12px -12px 0 rgba(7,17,31,.1), 0 15px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.egg-card img { width: 150px; height: 150px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); }
.egg-card strong { letter-spacing: .08em; }
.screen-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.eyebrow { margin: 0 0 7px; color: var(--yellow); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .16em; font-weight: 800; }
h1, h2 { margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); line-height: .95; }
.rules-note { margin: 11px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .045em; }
.selection-readout { min-width: 98px; text-align: right; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--muted); }
.selection-readout span { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 900; }

.difficulty-panel { margin: 0 0 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.difficulty-panel legend { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .13em; }
.difficulty-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.difficulty-option { position: relative; min-height: 63px; display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(11,30,53,.72); padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.difficulty-option:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--yellow); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,197,66,.16), rgba(11,30,53,.92)); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--yellow); }
.difficulty-option:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
.difficulty-option input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.difficulty-option span { display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.difficulty-option b { font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .09em; }
.difficulty-option small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .67rem; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: .025em; }

.roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.rental-card { position: relative; min-height: 226px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(27, 95, 136, .28), rgba(7, 17, 31, .96)); color: var(--cream); text-align: left; padding: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, background .16s ease; }
.rental-card:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(245, 197, 66, .65); }
.rental-card.selected { border: 2px solid var(--yellow); padding: 13px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(245, 197, 66, .2), rgba(7, 17, 31, .94)); }
.rental-card:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .55; }
.rental-name { display: block; position: relative; z-index: 2; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .05em; font-size: 1.02rem; }
.rental-meta { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.rental-xp { position: absolute; top: 58px; left: 14px; right: 14px; height: 5px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
.rental-xp i { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--mint), #b4f3d4); }
.rental-sprite { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 62px; width: 126px; height: 126px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.48)); }
.type-pills { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 78px; z-index: 2; display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
.type-pill { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(7,17,31,.68); padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: .62rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.stat-grid { position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; z-index: 3; }
.stat-grid > span { display: grid; gap: 2px; justify-items: center; padding: 5px 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.055); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
.stat-grid small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .58rem; letter-spacing: .05em; }
.stat-grid b { font: 800 .72rem ui-monospace, monospace; }
.selected-index { display: none; position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 10px; z-index: 4; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; width: 27px; height: 27px; place-items: center; font-weight: 900; }
.selected .selected-index { display: grid; }
.lock-label { position: absolute; inset: auto 14px 19px; z-index: 5; color: var(--cream); font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; font-weight: 800; }
.rental-card:disabled .stat-grid, .rental-card:disabled .type-pills, .rental-card:disabled .rental-xp { opacity: .15; }
.selection-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin-top: 22px; }
.selection-note { color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; }
.mode-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.primary-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 30px; border: 0; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); min-height: 54px; padding: 0 22px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 rgba(245,197,66,.2); }
.primary-button:disabled { background: #53616d; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }
.primary-button span { font-size: 1.7rem; line-height: 1; }
.secondary-button { min-height: 54px; border: 1px solid var(--mint); background: rgba(117,224,177,.08); color: var(--mint); padding: 0 20px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; }
.secondary-button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

.shop-balance { color: var(--yellow); font: 900 1.8rem ui-monospace, monospace; }
.shop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.shop-card { min-height: 175px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--navy); padding: 18px; }
.shop-card.locked { opacity: .5; }
.shop-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.shop-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; font-size: .82rem; }
.shop-card footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.shop-card footer span { color: var(--yellow); font: 800 .78rem ui-monospace, monospace; }
.shop-card button { border: 1px solid var(--yellow); background: transparent; color: var(--yellow); padding: 8px 11px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.shop-card button:disabled { border-color: var(--line); color: var(--muted); cursor: not-allowed; }

.badge-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
.badge-card { min-height: 150px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--navy); padding: 14px; }
.badge-card.locked { opacity: .45; filter: grayscale(1); }
.badge-card.current { border-color: var(--yellow); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--yellow); }
.badge-icon { width: 54px; height: 54px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--yellow); font: 900 1rem ui-monospace, monospace; transform: rotate(-8deg); }
.badge-card strong { display: block; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.badge-card small { display: block; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 5px; font-size: .68rem; line-height: 1.35; }
.badge-card button { margin-top: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--yellow); background: transparent; color: var(--yellow); padding: 7px 9px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 900; }
.badge-card button:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
.elite-panel { margin-top: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,197,66,.09), var(--navy)); padding: 18px; }
.elite-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 7px; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.elite-panel p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 14px; }

.streak-panel { display: grid; justify-items: end; color: var(--muted); font-size: .68rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.streak-panel b { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 2.5rem; }
.format-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.format-grid article { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--navy); padding: 22px; }
.format-grid article > strong { font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: .09em; }
.format-grid article p { min-height: 46px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; }
.format-grid .primary-button { width: 100%; }
.trainer-gallery { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; overflow: hidden; }
.trainer-gallery figure { min-width: 100px; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: .62rem; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.trainer-gallery img { display: block; width: 82px; height: 82px; margin: auto; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45)); }

.field-warning { margin-bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--yellow); background: rgba(245,197,66,.1); color: var(--yellow); padding: 11px 13px; font-size: .8rem; }
.safari-field { position: relative; min-height: 520px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(245,197,66,.35); background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 74%, rgba(0,0,0,.12) 75%) 0 0 / 72px 36px, linear-gradient(225deg, transparent 74%, rgba(255,255,255,.04) 75%) 0 0 / 72px 36px, linear-gradient(#9bbd58, #6d9847); box-shadow: inset 0 0 90px rgba(30,64,35,.55); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 19%, 100% 81%, 50% 100%, 0 81%, 0 19%); }
.safari-field::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 42%; height: 22%; transform: skewY(-12deg); background: rgba(226,188,99,.58); border-top: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-bottom: 3px solid rgba(62,63,28,.18); }
.safari-mon { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 112px; min-height: 118px; display: grid; justify-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--cream); cursor: pointer; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); animation: safariIdle 2.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.safari-mon img { width: 88px; height: 88px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 9px 4px rgba(7,17,31,.48)); }
.safari-mon span { background: rgba(7,17,31,.82); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 4px 7px; font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .05em; white-space: nowrap; }
.safari-mon.aggressive span { color: #fff; border-color: var(--red); background: rgba(133,35,35,.9); }
.safari-mon.aggressive { animation: safariAggressive .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.safari-legend { color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; }
.safari-legend span { color: var(--mint); font-weight: 900; }
.safari-legend b { color: var(--red); }

.dex-totals { display: flex; gap: 16px; }
.dex-totals span { display: grid; color: var(--muted); font-size: .66rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.dex-totals b { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 1.6rem; }
.pokedex-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 7px; }
.dex-entry { min-height: 126px; display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(11,30,53,.75); padding: 7px; text-align: center; }
.dex-entry img { width: 72px; height: 72px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.dex-entry.unseen img { filter: brightness(0); opacity: .32; }
.dex-entry.seen:not(.caught) img { filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .72; }
.dex-entry strong { font-size: .66rem; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.dex-entry small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .58rem; margin-top: 3px; }
.dex-entry.caught { border-color: rgba(117,224,177,.5); }

.save-tools { margin:12px 0 20px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #647c90; background:#102338; font-size:14px; }
.save-tools summary { cursor:pointer; color:#c5e5d7; }
.save-tools[data-saved=false] summary { color:#ffd16b; }
.save-tools p { line-height:1.5; max-width:800px; }
.save-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; }
.save-actions a { color:#ffdc74; }
.save-actions label { display:grid; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; }
.save-actions input { max-width:230px; font-size:14px; }
.battle-screen { max-width: 1040px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
.match-strip { min-height: 38px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font-size: .68rem; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.match-strip strong { font-size: .78rem; }
.match-strip strong { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.match-strip strong img { width: 30px; height: 30px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.match-strip span:last-child { text-align: right; }
.arena-wrap { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: linear-gradient(#163a5f 0 24%, #225d79 24% 38%, #87a85c 38% 100%); }
.crowd { height: 62px; opacity: .7; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #f5c542 0 2px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle, #f5f7eb 0 2px, transparent 3px); background-size: 23px 20px, 31px 24px; background-position: 0 0, 8px 5px; border-bottom: 5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.arena { position: relative; height: min(48vw, 430px); min-height: 350px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 40%, rgba(245,247,235,.4) 0 18%, transparent 19%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 25% 78%, rgba(245,247,235,.3) 0 21%, transparent 22%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 90px); }
.fighter { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.status-card { position: absolute; width: min(340px, 40%); top: 30px; left: 28px; background: rgba(245,247,235,.94); color: var(--ink); border: 4px solid var(--ink); padding: 12px 14px 10px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(7,17,31,.35); z-index: 3; }
.player-status-card { top: auto; left: auto; right: 28px; bottom: 27px; }
.status-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.status-title strong { font-size: 1rem; }
.status-title span { font-size: .74rem; }
.hp-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 9px; font-size: .63rem; font-weight: 900; }
.hp-track { height: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #ced6c8; padding: 1px; }
.hp-track i { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #28b36f; transition: width .45s ease, background .2s ease; }
.hp-numbers { text-align: right; font: 700 .72rem ui-monospace, monospace; margin-top: 4px; }
.status-tag { min-height: 14px; margin-top: 4px; color: #a02f2f; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.sprite-pad { position: absolute; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 250px; height: 200px; }
.enemy-pad { right: 9%; top: 15%; }
.player-pad { left: 8%; bottom: 3%; }
.battle-sprite { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 180px; height: 180px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 4px rgba(7,17,31,.34)); transition: transform .2s ease, opacity .2s ease; }
.player-sprite { width: 210px; height: 210px; }
.shadow { position: absolute; z-index: 1; bottom: 14px; width: 75%; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(7,17,31,.25); filter: blur(2px); }
.attack-right { animation: attackRight .34s ease; }
.attack-left { animation: attackLeft .34s ease; }
.hit { animation: hit .35s ease; }
.faint { transform: translateY(90px) !important; opacity: 0; }
.effect-flash { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; background: white; }
.effect-flash.flash { animation: flash .25s ease; }
.duo-partner { position: absolute; z-index: 2; display: grid; justify-items: center; color: var(--ink); font-size: .6rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.duo-partner img { width: 92px; height: 92px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: drop-shadow(0 7px 3px rgba(7,17,31,.35)); }
.duo-partner span { background: rgba(245,247,235,.88); padding: 3px 5px; }
.enemy-duo { right: 30%; top: 36%; }
.player-duo { left: 31%; bottom: 22%; }

.battle-console { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #0b1e35; }
.announcer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 70px; padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.announcer-label, .command-label { color: var(--yellow); letter-spacing: .12em; font-weight: 800; font-size: .68rem; }
.announcer p { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .01em; }
.command-area { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 250px; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; }
.moves { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.move-button { min-height: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; text-align: left; background: #102b49; color: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.move-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--yellow); background: #163a5f; }
.move-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.move-name { display: block; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.move-type { display: block; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; font-size: .65rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.move-pp { font: 700 .76rem ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--yellow); }
.team-column { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); padding-left: 14px; }
.team-buttons { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
.team-button { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; color: var(--cream); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
.team-button.current { border-color: var(--yellow); }
.team-button.partner { border-color: var(--mint); }
.team-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.team-button img { width: 32px; height: 32px; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.team-button span { font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; }
.team-button em { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--yellow); font-size: .58rem; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.team-button small { font: .65rem ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted); }
.bag-label { display: block; margin-top: 14px; }
.battle-items { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }
.item-button { min-height: 35px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); color: var(--cream); padding: 5px 7px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.item-button b { float: right; color: var(--yellow); }
.item-button:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }

.modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(3,9,17,.82); padding: 20px; }
.modal-card { width: min(480px, 100%); background: var(--navy); border: 1px solid rgba(245,197,66,.7); box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 rgba(245,197,66,.15); padding: 34px; }
.modal-card h2 { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 9vw, 4.6rem); color: var(--yellow); }
.modal-card p:not(.eyebrow) { color: #c1ccd4; line-height: 1.55; }
.modal-card .primary-button { width: 100%; margin-top: 20px; }
.reward { min-height: 20px; display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--cream); font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.reward span { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 7px; }
.reward span b { color: var(--mint); text-align: right; }
.reward > strong { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--yellow); letter-spacing: .08em; }

@keyframes attackRight { 50% { transform: translate(32px, -8px); } }
@keyframes attackLeft { 50% { transform: translate(-32px, 8px); } }
@keyframes hit { 25%, 75% { transform: translateX(-8px); filter: brightness(3); } 50% { transform: translateX(8px); } }
@keyframes flash { 50% { opacity: .45; } }
@keyframes eggWobble { 25% { transform: rotate(-6deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(7deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } }
@keyframes safariIdle { from { margin-top: -3px; } to { margin-top: 4px; } }
@keyframes safariAggressive { from { margin-left: -4px; } to { margin-left: 5px; filter: brightness(1.15); } }

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .shell { padding: 0 12px 22px; }
  .topbar { min-height: 62px; }
  .record { gap: 10px; }
  .record > span:not(.coin-bank) { display: none; }
  .record .music-button span { display: inline; }
  .starter-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .shop-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .badge-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .pokedex-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  .difficulty-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .difficulty-option { min-height: 54px; }
  .roster { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .rental-card { min-height: 220px; }
  .rental-sprite { width: 118px; height: 118px; }
  .arena { height: 420px; }
  .status-card { top: 16px; left: 12px; width: 55%; }
  .player-status-card { top: auto; left: auto; right: 12px; bottom: 16px; }
  .enemy-pad { right: -2%; top: 18%; }
  .player-pad { left: -4%; bottom: 2%; }
  .sprite-pad { width: 200px; height: 170px; }
  .battle-sprite { width: 145px; height: 145px; }
  .player-sprite { width: 170px; height: 170px; }
  .command-area { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .team-column { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 12px 0 0; }
  .team-buttons { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .team-button { grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; }
  .team-button small { display: none; }
  .safari-field { min-height: 440px; }
}

@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .brand { font-size: .82rem; gap: 7px; }
  .brand-mark { width: 23px; height: 23px; }
  .music-button b { display: none; }
  .music-button { width: 34px; justify-content: center; padding: 4px; }
  .text-button { font-size: .64rem; }
  .record { gap: 6px; }
  .coin-bank { font-size: .62rem; }
  .coin-bank b { font-size: .82rem; }
  .mode-nav { overflow-x: auto; }
  .onboarding-screen { margin-top: 28px; }
  .starter-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .starter-card { min-height: 205px; padding: 11px; }
  .starter-card img { width: 125px; height: 125px; }
  .egg-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .egg-card { min-height: 215px; }
  .egg-card img { width: 112px; height: 112px; }
  .egg-shape { transform: scale(.78); }
  .shop-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .badge-grid, .format-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .pokedex-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .dex-entry { min-height: 110px; }
  .dex-entry img { width: 62px; height: 62px; }
  .safari-field { min-height: 390px; clip-path: polygon(50% 0,100% 13%,100% 87%,50% 100%,0 87%,0 13%); }
  .safari-mon { width: 86px; }
  .safari-mon img { width: 70px; height: 70px; }
  .team-builder-controls { justify-items: end; }
  h1 { font-size: 2.1rem; }
  .screen { margin-top: 18px; }
  .screen-heading { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .roster { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .rental-card { min-height: 218px; padding: 12px; }
  .rental-card.selected { padding: 9px; }
  .rental-sprite { right: 14px; width: 122px; height: 122px; }
  .type-pills { left: 12px; top: 78px; }
  .selection-footer { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .mode-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .primary-button { width: 100%; }
  .match-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .match-strip strong { display: none; }
  .crowd { height: 44px; }
  .arena { min-height: 345px; height: 345px; }
  .status-card { width: 64%; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .enemy-pad { right: -10%; top: 16%; }
  .player-pad { left: -12%; bottom: 0; }
  .announcer { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; min-height: 72px; padding: 10px 12px; }
  .moves { gap: 6px; }
  .move-button { min-height: 62px; padding: 8px; }
  .move-name { font-size: .78rem; }
  .move-pp { font-size: .65rem; }
  .command-area { padding: 9px; }
  .modal-card { padding: 25px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
}

#box-manage-party{margin-top:12px;min-height:48px}.exp-setting{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px;border:1px solid #8091a2;border-radius:12px;background:#122b42;max-width:620px}.exp-setting input{width:24px;height:24px;flex-shrink:0}.exp-setting span{display:grid;gap:7px}.exp-setting small{line-height:1.5;color:#c6d7e1}.battle-exit-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding:4px 0}.battle-exit-actions button{min-height:40px}#settings-screen{padding:16px 0}


/* v4.2 post-battle progression */
#result-modal .modal-card{width:min(620px,100%);max-height:min(88dvh,760px);overflow:auto;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,34px)}
#result-modal .reward{gap:10px;margin-top:16px;letter-spacing:0}
.reward-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.reward-chip{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:10px!important;padding:12px!important;border:1px solid #ffffff20!important;background:#ffffff08;border-radius:10px}
.reward-chip .reward-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 34px;border-radius:50%;background:#f5c542;color:#07111f;font-size:18px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #07111f55}
.reward-chip.loss .reward-icon{background:#ff8b7a}.reward-chip b{display:block;color:var(--cream)!important;font-size:1rem}.reward-chip small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.xp-rewards{display:grid;gap:8px}.xp-card{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:46px 1fr;gap:10px!important;align-items:center;padding:10px!important;border:1px solid #ffffff18!important;background:#07111f88;border-radius:10px}
.xp-card img{width:46px;height:46px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}.xp-card-main{min-width:0}.xp-card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}.xp-card-head strong{font-size:.78rem}.xp-card-head b{color:var(--mint);font-size:.72rem}.xp-track{height:7px;margin-top:7px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:#ffffff18;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #0008}.xp-fill{height:100%;width:var(--xp-from,0%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5fe0b7,#9bf3d5);border-radius:inherit;transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.xp-card.level-up{border-color:#f5c54288;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #f5c54222}.xp-card.level-up .xp-card-head b{color:var(--yellow)}
.reward-major{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:10px!important;padding:13px!important;border:1px solid #f5c54266!important;background:#f5c54212;border-radius:10px;color:var(--yellow)!important}.reward-major .reward-icon{font-size:24px}.reward-major small{display:block;color:#d6dee5;margin-top:3px;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:0}.loot-reward{border-radius:10px!important;border:1px solid #f5c54288!important}.loot-reward .item-glyph{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:#07111f;color:#f5c542;font-size:17px}
@media(max-width:520px){.reward-summary{grid-template-columns:1fr}.xp-card{grid-template-columns:40px 1fr}.xp-card img{width:40px;height:40px}#result-modal.modal{padding:10px}#result-modal .modal-card{max-height:92dvh}}

</style>
    <style>
.workshop { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 16px; margin-top: 20px; background: #10263b; border-radius: 8px; }
.workshop summary { cursor: pointer; color: #f5c542; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }
.workshop p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; }
.workshop select, .move-choice select { width: 100%; padding: 10px; color: #f5f7eb; background: #102b45; border: 1px solid #52728d; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 16px; }
.learnset { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
.training-move { padding: 12px; text-align: left; color: #e8efee; background: #07111f; border: 1px solid #52728d; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }
.training-move[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: #f5c542; background: #364526; }
.training-move:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.command-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; color: #f5c542; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
.move-choice { min-width: 0; }
.move-choice .move-button { width: 100%; height: auto; min-height: 95px; }
.move-choice select { margin-top: 5px; }
.move-type { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.field-readout { padding: 12px 16px; background: #102b45; color: #f5c542; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; border-bottom: 1px solid #52728d; }
.battle-history { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 14px; }
.battle-history summary { cursor: pointer; color: #f5c542; }
.battle-history ol { max-height: 160px; overflow: auto; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 24px; }
.status-tag { max-width: 100%; white-space: normal; font-size: 12px; }
.battle-sprite[data-status=PAR] { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ffeb3b); }
.battle-sprite[data-status=BRN] { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ff5722); }
.battle-sprite[data-status=PSN], .battle-sprite[data-status=TOX] { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ab47bc); }
.battle-sprite[data-status=FRZ] { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #80deea); }
.battle-sprite[data-status=SLP] { opacity: .65; }
.battle-sprite[data-status]:not([data-status=""]) { animation: status-breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes status-breathe { from { opacity: .65; } to { opacity: 1; } }
.duo-partner span { max-width: 145px; font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .learnset { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .move-choice .move-button { padding: 10px; } .move-name { font-size: 14px; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .battle-sprite { animation: none !important; } }
/* Keep the full sprite box inside the arena on narrow screens. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .enemy-pad { right: 0; top: 23%; width: 42%; height: 140px; }
  .player-pad { left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 40%; height: 150px; }
  .battle-sprite, .player-sprite { width: min(140px, 100%); height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: contain; }
  .enemy-duo { right: 35%; top: 36%; }
  .player-duo { left: 5%; bottom: 38%; }
  .duo-partner img { width: 72px; height: 72px; }
}

</style>
    <style>
/* Fixed HUD over an independently moving perspective battlefield. */
.attack-canvas { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:2; pointer-events:none; }
.battle-screen .crowd { height: 30px; opacity: .45; }
.battle-screen .arena-wrap { background: #172632; }
.battle-screen .arena { height: 470px; min-height: 470px; isolation: isolate; background: linear-gradient(#101c2c, #3d606d 48%, #96ac96 49%, #536f63); }
.battle-world { position: absolute; inset: 0; perspective: 650px; transform-origin: 50% 57%; transition: transform 650ms cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.25,1); }
.battle-floor { position: absolute; left: -30%; top: 28%; width: 160%; height: 105%; transform: rotateX(62deg); transform-origin: 50% 35%; border: 3px solid #ccded580; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 74px, #effff820 75px 77px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #6b8c78 0 74px, #b6d5b650 75px 77px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 90px #172f30; }
.battle-screen .fighter { pointer-events: none; z-index: 3; }
.battle-screen .status-card { top: 18px; left: 18px; width: 44%; max-width: 390px; border: 2px solid #dce9df; border-left: 6px solid #f5c542; background: #10212deb; color: #f0f7f2; box-shadow: 5px 6px 0 #07121d70; padding: 12px; }
.battle-screen .player-status-card { top: auto; left: auto; right: 18px; bottom: 16px; }
.battle-detail { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: #bad0d9; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.battle-screen .status-tag { letter-spacing: 0; color: #ffd683; }
.battle-screen .hp-track { height: 12px; border-color: #06131d; }
.battle-world .enemy-pad { right: 10%; top: 24%; width: 24%; height: 175px; }
.battle-world .player-pad { left: 9%; bottom: 1%; width: 29%; height: 225px; }
.battle-world .battle-sprite { width: 170px; height: 170px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: contain; transform-origin: 50% 90%; }
.battle-world .player-sprite { width: 220px; height: 220px; }
.battle-world .sprite-pad::before { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 130%; height: 42%; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #c9decb90; background: #aec29b; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #4c6b59, 0 14px 25px #14282160; }
.battle-world .enemy-duo { right: 36%; top: 35%; }
.battle-world .player-duo { left: 37%; bottom: 33%; }
.battle-world .duo-partner span { background: #10212de8; color: #edf5f0; padding: 4px 6px; max-width: 160px; }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic] .sprite-pad > img { animation: bw-idle 1.7s ease-in-out infinite; }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic] .enemy-pad > img { animation-delay: -.8s; }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic][data-focus=player] .battle-world { transform: perspective(900px) translate(2%, -1%) rotateY(-4deg) scale(1.045) rotate(-1deg); }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic][data-focus=enemy] .battle-world { transform: perspective(900px) translate(-2%, 1%) rotateY(4deg) scale(1.06) rotate(1deg); }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic][data-focus=hit-enemy] .battle-world { transform: translate(-2%, 2%) scale(1.075); }
.arena[data-camera=dynamic][data-focus=hit-player] .battle-world { transform: translate(2%, -2%) scale(1.055); }
.arena[data-duo=true] .battle-world .player-pad { width: 25%; }
.arena[data-weather=rain] { background: linear-gradient(#111f3d, #527a9c 48%, #6d918d 49%, #345c5b); }

.map-marker { position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; border:3px solid #fff; background:#263647; color:#fff; font-weight:900; font-size:17px; box-shadow:0 3px 0 #091a28,0 4px 12px #0009; cursor:pointer; z-index:2; }
.map-marker.current { background:#f5c542; color:#102137; box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #f5c54266,0 4px 12px #000a; }
.map-marker.completed { background:#17735a; }
.map-marker.locked { background:#354657; border-color:#b8c4cd; }
.map-marker[aria-pressed=true] { outline:3px solid #fff; outline-offset:5px; z-index:3; }
.map-marker:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffdb5c; outline-offset:5px; }
.map-legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px 24px; font-size:14px; color:#c9dbe4; padding:16px 0; }
.map-legend span:first-child { color:#f5c542; }
.map-stop { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:20px; background:#102b43; border:1px solid #617b8e; border-left:5px solid var(--yellow); }
.map-stop>img { image-rendering:pixelated; object-fit:contain; flex-shrink:0; }
.map-stop>div { flex:1; }

.map-stop .stop-note { color:#bacdd9; }
@media(max-width:650px){ .map-stop { flex-wrap:wrap; padding:14px; gap:12px; }.map-stop>div { min-width:180px; }.map-stop>button { width:100%; }.map-stop h2 { font-size:20px; }.kanto-scroll { max-height:65vh; } }

/* Fit the entire journey on mobile without horizontal scrolling. */
.kanto-scroll{overflow:visible;max-height:none;padding:6px;border-color:#d7a43d;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#5e3f25,#172f42);box-shadow:0 14px 35px #020b1480}.kanto-map{min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:1536/1024;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}.kanto-map>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(1.04) contrast(1.02)}.map-marker{width:clamp(23px,4vw,44px);height:clamp(23px,4vw,44px);padding:2px}.journey-avatar{position:absolute;z-index:4;transform:translate(-50%,-110%);color:#ffe27b;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #061b32;font-size:clamp(16px,3vw,28px);pointer-events:none;transition:left .55s ease,top .55s ease}.kanto-scroll .kanto-badge{max-width:100%;max-height:100%}@media(max-width:600px){.kanto-scroll{padding:3px}.kanto-map{min-width:0}.map-marker{border-width:1px}.map-marker.current{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #f5c54266}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.journey-avatar{transition:none}}

    <style>
.kanto-badge { display:grid; place-items:center; width:28px; height:28px; border:2px solid #f4f6e9; border-radius:50%; background:#6f6655; color:#fff; font:900 16px/1 Arial,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 2px 0 #0a1724; flex-shrink:0; }
.kanto-badge.badge-1{background:#3985af}.kanto-badge.badge-2{background:#d59b22;color:#132235}.kanto-badge.badge-3{background:#579553}.kanto-badge.badge-4{background:#9b4e82}.kanto-badge.badge-5{background:#b25e91}.kanto-badge.badge-6{background:#c84c31}.kanto-badge.badge-7{background:#8b6841}
.map-marker { display:grid; place-items:center; }

.map-marker.completed::after { content:'✓'; position:absolute; right:-5px; bottom:-5px; width:18px; height:18px; font-size:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#146e51; border:1px solid white; color:white; }

.quick-mon small { color:var(--muted); font-size:.62rem; }
.quick-mon.empty { place-items:center; align-content:center; justify-content:center; border-style:dashed; color:#758b9f; cursor:default; }
.quick-mon.empty b { color:var(--yellow); font-size:1.2rem; }
.preset-heading { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin:20px 0 7px; color:var(--yellow); font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.1em; }
.preset-heading small { color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0; }
.party-presets { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:7px; }
.party-presets article { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto; gap:5px; align-items:center; border:1px solid #ffffff20; background:#071829; padding:9px; }
.party-presets article div { min-width:0; display:grid; gap:4px; }
.party-presets article strong { font-size:.68rem; color:var(--yellow); }
.party-presets article span { color:var(--muted); font-size:.62rem; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.party-presets button { border:1px solid #62829a; background:#102b49; color:#fff; padding:8px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.62rem; }
.party-presets button:disabled { opacity:.35; cursor:default; }
.quick-party-owned { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); gap:6px; max-height:310px; overflow:auto; padding-right:4px; }
.quick-party-card>footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-top:18px; color:var(--muted); }
.quick-party-card>footer .primary-button { min-height:46px; }
.party-editor-open { overflow:hidden; }
@media(max-width:700px){.party-tray{grid-template-columns:92px 1fr;padding:5px}.party-tray-label small{display:none}.party-tray-team{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,70px)}.tray-mon{min-width:70px;display:grid;justify-items:center;padding:3px}.tray-mon img{width:34px;height:34px}.tray-mon span{display:none}.quick-party-card{padding:14px}.quick-party-current{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.quick-party-owned{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.party-presets{grid-template-columns:1fr}.quick-mon{min-height:64px}.quick-mon img{width:42px;height:42px}.quick-party-card>footer{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.quick-party-card>footer .primary-button{width:100%}}

/* Explicit party editing: inspecting a slot never removes it. */
.quick-party-slot{min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-rows:1fr auto;gap:4px}.quick-party-slot>.quick-mon{width:100%;min-width:0}.quick-party-remove{min-height:38px;border:1px solid #e2a2a2;background:#41202a;color:#fff;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.quick-party-action{margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap;color:#f5c542;font-size:.67rem}.quick-party-owned .quick-mon:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.quick-party-owned .quick-mon[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#f5c542;background:#24445b}.quick-party-owned .quick-mon{min-height:64px}

</style>
    <style>
.trainer-identity { white-space:nowrap; }
.guide-button { margin-left:auto; color:var(--yellow); border:1px solid #f5c54255; }
.intro-open { overflow:hidden; }
.joke-intro { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:150; background:#030811; color:var(--cream); }
.intro-cinematic,.joke-guide-panel { position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; }
.intro-cinematic>img { position:absolute; inset:-6%; width:112%; height:112%; object-fit:cover; }
.cinema-map { opacity:1; image-rendering:auto; }
.cinema-stadium { opacity:0; }
.intro-cinematic.playing .cinema-map { animation:kanto-flight 8s ease-in-out both; }
.intro-cinematic.playing .cinema-stadium { animation:stadium-arrival 8s ease-in-out both; }
.cinema-vignette { position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 30%,#020610dd 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#02061055,#020610aa); }
.cinema-title { position:absolute; inset:0; display:grid; place-content:center; justify-items:center; text-align:center; padding:22px; text-shadow:0 5px 20px #000; }
.cinema-title span { color:var(--yellow); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.28em; }
.cinema-title h1 { margin:10px 0 8px; color:#fff; font-size:clamp(3.5rem,11vw,8.5rem); line-height:.72; filter:drop-shadow(8px 10px 0 #0b2b51); }
.cinema-title p { margin:18px 0 26px; font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:.12em; }
.cinema-title .primary-button { min-width:180px; }
.cinema-skip { position:absolute; top:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-top)); right:20px; border:1px solid #ffffff55; background:#061221aa; color:#fff; padding:10px 13px; cursor:pointer; }
@keyframes kanto-flight { 0%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05) translate(-2%,2%)}55%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.55) translate(5%,-6%)}72%,100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(2.1) translate(8%,-9%)} }
@keyframes stadium-arrival { 0%,52%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.65)}72%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.04)} }
.joke-guide-panel { display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto auto; width:min(1050px,100%); margin:auto; min-height:100%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 55%,#174f70 0,#0b2138 32%,#06111f 75%); }
.joke-guide-panel>header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:18px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff25; color:var(--yellow); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.15em; }
#guide-close { width:42px; height:42px; border:1px solid #ffffff35; background:transparent; color:#fff; font-size:1.6rem; cursor:pointer; }
.guide-stage { min-height:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:270px 1fr; align-items:center; gap:32px; padding:30px clamp(22px,5vw,65px); }
.guide-professor { display:grid; justify-items:center; align-content:end; min-height:390px; border-bottom:5px solid var(--yellow); background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 90%,#eff8d522 0,transparent 65%); }
.guide-professor img { width:250px; height:340px; object-fit:contain; object-position:bottom; image-rendering:pixelated; filter:drop-shadow(13px 15px 0 #02071188); }
.guide-professor strong { width:100%; background:var(--yellow); color:var(--ink); padding:10px; text-align:center; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.12em; }
.guide-content { min-height:250px; display:grid; align-content:center; gap:14px; border:2px solid #d9e5dd; background:#f1f4e9; color:#081321; padding:clamp(20px,4vw,42px); box-shadow:10px 12px 0 #02071188; }
.dialogue-speaker { color:#1b5f88; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.14em; }
.guide-content p { margin:0; font:700 clamp(1.1rem,2.5vw,1.65rem)/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace; }
.guide-content h2 { font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,3.5rem); color:#07111f; }
.player-line { background:#102b49; color:#fff; border-color:#f5c542; }
.player-line .dialogue-speaker { color:var(--yellow); }
.name-step form { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 120px 1fr; gap:9px; }
.name-step label { display:grid; gap:5px; color:#456070; font-size:.65rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.1em; }
.name-step input { width:100%; min-height:48px; border:2px solid #9db0b7; background:#fff; color:#07111f; padding:8px 10px; font:800 1rem ui-monospace,monospace; }
.guide-starters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:8px; }
.guide-starters button { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:5px; border:2px solid #9db0b7; background:#dcebdc; color:#07111f; padding:8px; cursor:pointer; }
.guide-starters button:hover,.guide-starters button:focus-visible { border-color:#1b5f88; transform:translateY(-3px); }
.guide-starters img { width:100px; height:100px; object-fit:contain; image-rendering:pixelated; }
.guide-starters small { color:#526976; font-size:.6rem; }
.joke-guide-panel>footer { padding:17px 24px; border-top:1px solid #ffffff25; }
.guide-actions { min-height:54px; display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; }
.guide-choice { min-height:50px; border:1px solid #86a5b8; background:#102b49; color:#fff; padding:0 18px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:900; }
.guide-tour-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:3px; padding:0 24px 16px; }
.guide-tour-tabs span { min-height:34px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #ffffff20; color:#70889b; font-size:.58rem; font-weight:900; }
.guide-tour-tabs span.active { color:#07111f; background:var(--yellow); border-color:var(--yellow); }
.guide-tour-tabs span.complete { color:var(--mint); border-color:#75e0b155; }
@media(max-width:720px){.trainer-identity{display:none}.guide-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-content:start;gap:12px;padding:14px}.guide-professor{min-height:145px;grid-template-columns:125px 1fr;align-items:end;border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow)}.guide-professor img{width:125px;height:145px}.guide-professor strong{align-self:end}.guide-content{min-height:260px;padding:18px}.guide-content p{font-size:1rem}.name-step form{grid-template-columns:1fr 72px 1fr}.guide-starters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.guide-starters img{width:78px;height:78px}.guide-tour-tabs{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 14px 8px}.guide-tour-tabs span{min-width:74px}.guide-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}.guide-actions button{width:100%}.joke-guide-panel>footer{padding:10px 14px}.cinema-title h1{font-size:3.8rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.intro-cinematic.playing .cinema-map{animation:none;opacity:0}.intro-cinematic.playing .cinema-stadium{animation:none;opacity:1;transform:none}}

</style>

.pokemon-detail-modal{z-index:200;overflow:auto;padding:18px}.pokemon-detail-card{position:relative;width:min(650px,100%);max-height:90dvh;overflow:auto;background:#102b49;border:2px solid #f5c542;padding:26px;color:#f5f7eb}.detail-close{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;background:#07111f;color:white;border:1px solid #829aad;padding:8px 14px;font-size:24px}.detail-content p{line-height:1.55}.detail-portrait{width:140px;height:140px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;display:block;margin:auto}.detail-content label{display:grid;gap:8px}.detail-content input,.summary-access select{font:inherit;padding:10px;background:#07111f;color:#fff;border:1px solid #829aad;max-width:100%}.detail-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px}.detail-stats dd{margin:0;color:#f5c542}.detail-action{padding:12px;margin:5px 5px 5px 0;background:#07111f;color:#f5c542;border:1px solid #f5c542;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.summary-access{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:18px 0}.move-explanation{padding:8px;color:#c5dbe6;font-size:14px}.move-explanation summary{cursor:pointer}.match-recap{grid-column:1/-1;padding:15px;border:1px solid #829aad}.details-open{overflow:hidden}.evolution-reveal{animation:evolution-reveal 1.3s ease-out}@keyframes evolution-reveal{0%{filter:brightness(8);transform:scale(.2)}60%{filter:brightness(3);transform:scale(1.15)}100%{filter:brightness(1);transform:scale(1)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.evolution-reveal{animation:none}}

    <style>
/* Bounded dialogs: content scrolls while navigation stays reachable. */
.joke-intro{height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh}

.guide-stage{overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;align-items:start;align-content:start}
.joke-guide-panel>footer{background:#0b2138;padding-bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:2}
.guide-professor{min-height:0}.guide-content{min-height:0}
.modal{max-height:100dvh;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:12px}

.battle-command-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:#f5c542;color:#07111f;border-color:#f5c542}
.battle-console .command-area{display:block}.command-pane{outline-offset:-3px}.command-pane[hidden]{display:none!important}
#command-pane-info .camera-controls{position:static;transform:none;max-width:none;flex-direction:row;justify-content:start;margin:10px 0}
.battle-move-help details{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff25}.battle-move-help summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}.battle-move-help p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
#command-pane-info .battle-history{margin:10px}#command-pane-info .stadium-broadcast{margin:10px 0}
@media(max-width:800px){
 .shell{padding:0 10px 16px}.topbar{min-height:58px;gap:8px}.record{gap:8px}.record>span:not(.coin-bank){display:none}.brand{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em}
 .mode-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;overflow:visible;padding-top:8px}.nav-button{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.03em;min-height:44px;padding:8px 4px;background:#102b49;border:1px solid #ffffff22}.nav-button.active{background:#f5c542;color:#07111f}.guide-button{margin:0;grid-column:1/-1;min-height:36px}
 .party-tray{grid-template-columns:78px minmax(0,1fr);position:static}.party-tray-team{grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--party-slots,3),minmax(32px,1fr));overflow:visible}.tray-mon{min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:2px}.tray-mon img{width:32px;height:32px}.party-tray>.detail-action{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;padding:8px;min-height:36px;font-size:12px}.party-tray-label span{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0}
 .selection-footer .mode-actions{display:none}.screen{margin-top:16px}.screen-heading h1{font-size:30px}.screen-heading{gap:10px}.format-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.format-grid .primary-button{width:100%;min-height:48px;font-size:14px}
 .guide-professor{grid-template-columns:90px 1fr;min-height:0}.guide-professor img{width:90px;height:95px}.guide-stage{gap:10px;padding:12px}.guide-content{min-height:0;padding:16px}.guide-content p{font-size:16px}.joke-guide-panel>header{padding:8px 12px;min-height:45px}.guide-actions{gap:6px;min-height:0}.guide-actions button{min-height:44px;font-size:14px;padding:10px;letter-spacing:0}.guide-tour-tabs{max-height:40px}.guide-starters img{width:64px;height:64px}.name-step form{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 65px minmax(0,1fr)}
 .scene-stage{min-height:120px}.scene-stage>img{height:120px;width:120px}.scene-card{padding:12px}.scene-dialogue p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4}.scene-dialogue{padding:10px}.scene-card h2{margin-bottom:8px}
